## 📱 App Information

Submit your app once using this form. English, العربية, 简体中文, 日本語, Deutsch, and Español are welcome. Maintainers will review the app and handle the English listing and translations; you do not need to translate it yourself.

**App Name:**  
<!-- e.g., IINA, Rectangle, Maccy -->

**Website/GitHub:**  
<!-- Official website or repository URL -->

**Category:**  
<!-- e.g., Video & Media, Window Management, Productivity, Developer Tools -->
<!-- See README for full list of categories -->

**Pricing:**  
<!-- Choose ONE: Free, Free + Open Source, Freemium, Paid, Subscription -->

**One-line Description (< 100 chars):**  
<!-- Brief description of what the app does -->
<!-- Good: "Modern video player with native macOS design." -->
<!-- Bad: "The best video player ever made!" -->

## ✅ Requirements Checklist

Please confirm the app meets ALL these requirements:

- [ ] Built with native macOS frameworks (Swift/SwiftUI/AppKit/Objective-C)
- [ ] NOT an Electron app or web wrapper
- [ ] Lightweight and fast (doesn't use excessive resources)
- [ ] Actively maintained (updated within last 2 years)
- [ ] Currently available for download
- [ ] Works on currently supported macOS versions
- [ ] Not already listed in the README
- [ ] No malware, adware, or suspicious behavior
- [ ] I am not the developer (unless it's truly exceptional)

## 💡 Why This App? (Optional)

<!-- What makes this app special? Why should it be on the list? -->

---

**Note:** Apps that don't meet the native requirement will not be added. When in doubt, check if the app uses Swift/AppKit or if it's just a web wrapper.

**🐦 Want extra visibility?** Send your app to us on [X (@NativeMacApps)](https://x.com/NativeMacApps) for a chance at an individual spotlight post, separate from this listing. [Follow us](https://x.com/NativeMacApps) to catch it.

**Thank you for contributing!** 🙏
